items_flat.title_en: Musk says he still prefers the Grok app to Grok Bot on hard tasks
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克稱難題上仍較常用 Grok App，而非 Grok Bot
items_flat.summary_en: On 30 Aug 19:36 UTC, Elon Musk posted that he personally still finds the Grok app more useful than Grok Bot for some tasks and urged users to retry the app on difficult work, linking the iOS Grok app. No new named model or API ship accompanied the post.
items_flat.summary_zh: 8月30日 19:36 UTC，Elon Musk 發文稱自己在部分任務上仍覺得 Grok App 比 Grok Bot 好用，並建議使用者拿難題再試一次 App，同時附上 iOS Grok App 連結。貼文未伴隨新模型或 API 發布。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is executive product positioning, not a model release. It signals xAI is still treating the consumer Grok app and the Bot/teammate surface as distinct, with the app remaining the reference experience for hard interactive work.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是執行長層級的產品定位，不是模型發布。它顯示 xAI 仍把消費端 Grok App 與 Bot／隊友介面分開看待，難題互動仍以 App 為對照基準。
items_flat.quote: Should say that I personally still find the @Grok app more useful for some tasks than @Bot. Worth trying it out on super tough tasks if you haven’t in a while.
items_flat.quote_zh: 應該說，我個人在某些任務上仍覺得 @Grok App 比 @Bot 更有用。若一陣子沒試過，值得拿超難的任務再試試看。

items_flat.title_en: Musk highlights shareable Grok Bot templates as a way to pass on workflows
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克轉發 Grok Bot 模板：用連結分享工作流
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk quote-posted SpaceXAI engineer Matt Palmer’s note that Grok Bot templates package skills, memories, and plugins into a shareable link—described as a blueprint or workflow—and captioned it “How to share your Grok @Bot design with others.” xAI’s news page did not add a separate templates announcement in this window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 轉發 SpaceXAI 工程師 Matt Palmer 說明：Grok Bot 模板把技能、記憶與外掛打成可分享連結，被稱為藍圖或工作流；馬斯克配文「如何把你的 Grok @Bot 設計分享給別人」。此時間窗內 xAI 官網未另發模板專文。
items_flat.analysis_en: If templates work as described, Bot value shifts from one-off agents toward portable playbooks. The posts do not say whether templates are generally available, how permissions work, or what is stripped when a link is shared.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若模板如所述運作，Bot 價值會從一次性代理人轉向可攜工作手冊。貼文未說明是否全面開放、權限如何處理，以及分享連結時會剝離哪些內容。
items_flat.quote: How to share your Grok @Bot design with others
items_flat.quote_zh: 如何把你的 Grok @Bot 設計分享給別人

items_flat.title_en: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 preview reaches scheduled shutdown date
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 預覽版於今日依時程下線
items_flat.summary_en: Google’s Gemini API deprecations table lists gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview with a shutdown date of August 31, 2026, and names gemini-robotics-er-2-preview as the replacement. The cutoff was announced with the ER 2 preview in July; no new DeepMind blog post appeared in the last 12 hours.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Gemini API 下架表將 gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview 的關閉日訂為 2026年8月31日，並指定 gemini-robotics-er-2-preview 為替代。時程隨 7 月 ER 2 預覽一併公布；過去 12 小時無新的 DeepMind 部落格。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a calendar event, not a new robotics model. Teams still on the 1.6 preview endpoint need to cut over today or lose the API. Whether production robots were still pinned to 1.6 is not disclosed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既定下架日，不是新機器人模型。仍掛在 1.6 預覽端點的團隊今日必須切換，否則會失去 API。實際有多少產線機器人仍釘在 1.6，官方未說明。
items_flat.quote: The gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview model will be shut down on August 31, 2026.
items_flat.quote_zh: gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview 模型將於 2026年8月31日關閉。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral Medium 3 and 3.1 API IDs reach scheduled retirement
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral Medium 3 與 3.1 API 代號依時程退役
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral’s model docs list mistral-medium-2505 (Medium 3) and mistral-medium-2508 (Medium 3.1) with retirement on 8/31/2026, pointing developers to Mistral Medium 3.5. No new Mistral blog post in the last 12 hours accompanied the date.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 模型文件將 mistral-medium-2505（Medium 3）與 mistral-medium-2508（Medium 3.1）的退役日列為 2026/8/31，並導向 Mistral Medium 3.5。過去 12 小時沒有對應的新部落格。
items_flat.analysis_en: A scheduled API sunset, not a new open-weight drop. Integrators still calling the 2505/2508 IDs should expect breakage today; quality and price of the 3.5 successor versus these IDs is outside this window.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既定 API 日落，不是新的開源權重。仍呼叫 2505／2508 的整合商今天可能中斷；3.5 相對這兩檔的品質與價格不在本窗範圍。
items_flat.quote_zh: Mistral Medium 3.1｜25.08｜mistral-medium-2508｜棄用 2026/5/22、退役 2026/8/31｜改用 Mistral Medium 3.5

brief_en: A quiet Monday. No flagship model launches. Overnight, Elon Musk positioned the consumer Grok app as still better than Grok Bot on hard tasks and amplified shareable Bot templates. Google’s Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 preview and two Mistral Medium API IDs reach scheduled shutdown today.
brief_zh: 今日偏靜。無旗艦模型發表。馬斯克隔夜強調 Grok App 在難題上仍優於 Grok Bot，並轉發可分享的 Bot 模板。Google Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 預覽與兩款 Mistral Medium API 依既定時程於今日下線。
